# giuggiai-meter

> Open-source Python library (MIT, zero dependencies, Python 3.10+) that records the token usage of every AI API call per project, prices it with a dated price list and reconciles the monthly cost with the official bill of each provider. Since 0.2 it also enforces budgets before a call (switch to a cheaper model or refuse), values flat subscription plans at list price, measures cost per accepted result with model advice, and forecasts when a budget runs out. It does not store prompts or answers and is not a proxy, a gateway or a tracing platform.

## Verified facts
- One line to plug in: `client = giuggiai_meter.wrap(OpenAI(), project="name")`; responses come back unchanged.
- Providers: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Mistral, Cohere, AWS Bedrock, Ollama, Groq, Together, Fireworks, OpenRouter, Perplexity, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Storage: one local SQLite file, readable by its owner only. Optional HTTP ingest with a shared token for other machines.
- Commands: `giuggiai-meter demo`, `init`, `report --month YYYY-MM [--csv | --html FILE] [--budgets FILE]`, `reconcile --month YYYY-MM --official Provider=USD ...`, `ingest`, `log`, `status [--json]`, `advise --kind K`, `units`, `plans`, `migrate`.
- Budgets (0.2): `giuggiai_meter.check(project, model=..., source=...)` returns a Decision (allow, warn, degrade, block); `wrap(client, project=..., budgets=True)` applies it before each call and raises `BudgetExceeded` when blocked. Budgets live in one JSON file (`GIUGGIAI_METER_BUDGETS`). It is a library inside your process, not a proxy.
- Units and outcomes (0.2): `with giuggiai_meter.unit(id, kind):` and `giuggiai_meter.outcome(id, accepted=True)`; `advise` recommends a cheaper model only with at least 20 results per model and at most 5 points lower acceptance.
- Metering errors never raise into the caller's code.
- Prices are matched by (provider, model): an entry with a `provider` applies to that provider only, an entry without one applies to every provider.

## What it does NOT do
- It does not record streaming calls, batches or embeddings automatically (they can be logged by hand).
- It does not ship real prices: the bundled price list is an example with placeholder values.
- It does not route between providers, cache, retry or trace calls (budgets can only switch the model name or refuse a call), and it does not send data anywhere unless the ingest is configured.
- It is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any AI provider.
